description: Generate a client-ready performance report in Markdown (ready for email, Notion or an assistant) or print-to-PDF branded HTML using the brand’s saved name and colours (Studio and Pro). Supports period, source, campaign tag filter, custom cover title and executive notes; hideBranding removes the Spica Post footer on Pro. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: Reporting period: 7, 30 or 90 days. 30 when left out.

format.description: Output format: "markdown" (default, ready for email, Notion or an assistant) or "html" (branded, print-to-PDF layout).

hideBranding.description: true removes the Spica Post footer for white-label agency delivery (Pro only). Defaults to false.

notes.description: Optional executive summary or client notes shown at the top of the report (up to 2000 characters).

tag.description: Optional campaign tag to scope the report to one campaign.

title.description: Optional custom cover heading (up to 120 characters).

name: results_report
title: Generate a client performance report
